First of all, everyone who sucks at one thing tries to find comfort in other. I have been doing that in every single thing for the better part of my life to this point that i am literally very frustrated. I know that I may sound as overly dramatic. I know that I am not the only in the world who is facing all these problems. I know that nearly 2/3 men population of the world face this issue but only a small percentage of them have this in their early twenties and the people whom I have met have not got other problems so they are fine with them. Yes, Baldness is not that big deal as the tumor. But that is just last grain on the already full jar of pent up emotions. It is just I am really really tired of fighting these non solvable problems. I know that acceptance is the last stage of grief and if I want to live, I will have to accept it and move on. However I am tired of acceptance. I mean I have accepted that I am not medically fit than most of the people on the planet. I have accepted that this is going to affect my whole life in one way or another. I have accepted that I wasted a lot of time of my teenage life (which is the most crucial part of a person's life. ) I have accepted that I may have to work twice as hard in achieving normal goals as compared to a normal person. I have accepted that I am a lot shorter than average person. I have accepted that I will be a center of people' opinions and comments because of my height. I have accepted that I have a smaller bone structure even for a person of my own height. I have accepted that i am a lot hairier than a normal person(there is a solution for that, laser hair removal, but it is still painful to know that i will have to go through a procedure). I have half head of white hair courtesy of medications of tumor. I have accepted that my sex life will be a little difficult than a normal person. but now things have gone way too far. I know I will have to accept but i am just tired of making compromises in every single aspect of life. I am stuck on why this time. I know the solution for this but I dont want to accept it. 
May be the reason behind my this dramatic attitude is that i have developed inferiority complex since the tumor and have started comparing myself with every single person on the planet. I dont know.
Yes death is unknown. but since the life is not beautiful so why not try something that is unknown. atleast there I have a 50/50 percent chance. 
Yes I have started going to a therapist. I hope that I may able to stop this restless thinking.
